semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in vacuum eutectic furnaces crucial for semiconductor packaging processes.
summary: Beijing Torch SMT Incorporated Company develops and manufactures thermally activated vacuum eutectic furnaces used in semiconductor packaging. These furnaces are designed to enhance solder wettability and reduce void ratios by controlling temperature, pressure, and atmosphere during the vacuum eutectic process, thereby improving packaging yield.
capabilities: Infrared and hot plate heating methods
